== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Dornoth refers to a star system located within the [[Galactic Union]]. The system is home to several planets, including [[Dornoth One]], which serves as a sibling world to the [[Lichborn]] homeworld. [[Dornoth Two]] is noted for experiencing storms, while [[Dornoth Three]] is a purple-surfaced planet encased in metal satellites and stations; however, its volatile volcanoes frequently launch corrosive chemicals and debris into orbit. Dornoth IV{{!}}Dornoth Four is the homeworld of the [[Lichborn]], housing roughly one hundred million residents on the surface and billions more on surrounding space stations. This planet is characterized by a toxic landscape featuring infectious flames, poisonous swamps, and acid clouds, earning it a reputation as one of the most inhospitable inhabited worlds in the galaxy. The system also contains an uninhabited moon near [[Dornoth Three]] that hosts an automated spaceport. The system is culturally and technologically defined by the [[Lichborn]], whose ships typically feature skeletal designs and green engine fire. One of the system's most valuable natural resources is night-diamonds, a type of powdered diamond that requires special government permission to acquire. The [[Dornoth system]] is also an area of significant corporate and military activity, involving the [[Vallenar Corporation]] and various naval fleets. Additionally, the system has been a site of conflict involving the D’Niss{{!}}D'Niss swarm and the [[Grand Hive]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Dornoth serves as a destination for Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri and [[Nila]], with Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri officially ordering a course toward the location. As the ship travels on its set path, it approaches Dornoth's orbit. The destination is a place containing various lockups and possesses a long, proud history regarding the gift for armor.}}
